mainEntity.name: Can AI really help me create passive income, or is that just a sales pitch?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can reduce drafting and coordination time, but “passive income” is not an automatic result of using it. Run My AI Biz presents digital products, newsletters, memberships, affiliate marketing, websites, and directories as possible models, not guaranteed income streams. Context: Each model still requires demand validation, useful delivery, marketing, customer support, maintenance, and business judgment. Key factors: - Choose a problem and audience before choosing a revenue model. - Calculate creation, platform, promotion, support, and update work. - Test a small offer before building a broad portfolio. Practical guidance: Use AI to compare models and prepare a focused pilot, then measure customer interest, delivery effort, and repeatability. Avoid claims that a bot or prompt creates typical earnings unless you have reliable evidence.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can lower the effort needed for research, drafting, and recurring tasks, but it does not create guaranteed passive income. Every model still needs demand, quality delivery, marketing, support, maintenance, and evidence that customers will pay.
